votes.motion: Approve the Work Session meeting minutes of June 2, 2022 and August 9, 2022 as well as Formal meeting minutes of August 6, 2022 and Truth-in-Taxation meeting minutes of August 16, 2022 and August 29, 2022.
votes.description: Approval of several prior meeting minutes including work session, formal, and truth-in-taxation meetings from mid-2022.

votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 27 of 2022, a joint ceremonial resolution declaring November as Native American Heritage Month in Salt Lake City.
votes.description: A ceremonial resolution jointly adopted with Mayor Mendenhall recognizing November as Native American Heritage Month in Salt Lake City.

votes.motion: Close the Public Hearing and refer Item B-1 to a future Consent Agenda for action.
votes.description: Closes the public hearing on the Know Your Neighbor grant application to the Open Society Foundation and defers action to a future consent agenda.

votes.motion: Close the Public Hearing/Meeting regarding the General Obligation Bond for Parks, Trails and Open Space.
votes.description: Closes the public meeting held to accept comment on the $85 million general obligation bond ballot proposition for parks, trails, and open space.

votes.motion: Close the Public Hearing and defer action on the Salt Lake City International Airport Master Plan to a future meeting.
votes.description: Closes the public hearing on the 2022 Airport Master Plan Update and defers Council action to a future meeting.

votes.motion: Close the Public Hearing and defer action on the Alley Vacation at approximately 925 South 1200 West to a future Council Meeting.
votes.description: Closes the public hearing on a proposed alley vacation adjacent to 925 South 1200 West and defers action to a future meeting.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 66 of 2022, amending various sections of Title 21A pertaining to shared housing.
votes.description: Amends Salt Lake City zoning code to redefine Single Room Occupancy housing as Shared Housing, allowing units with multiple sleeping rooms and either a private kitchen or bathroom but not both.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 67 of 2022, amending various sections of Title 21A pertaining to off-street parking, mobility, and loading zones.
votes.description: Amends Salt Lake City zoning code to simplify off-street parking regulations, address enforcement issues, and respond to changing development patterns.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 68 of 2022, amending various sections of Title 21A pertaining to RMF-30 Low Density Multi-family Residential District, and wait to publish the ordinance for 180 calendar days.
votes.description: Amends the RMF-30 zoning district to remove barriers to multi-family housing development, with a 180-day delay in publication to allow time for related ordinances to be developed.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 69 of 2022, amending the zoning of a property at approximately 16 South 800 West from Transit Station Area District – Urban Neighborhood Station Transition (TSA-UN-T) to Transit Station Area District – Urban Neighborhood Station-Core (TSA-UN-C).
votes.description: Rezones the property at 16 South 800 West to allow for a mixed-use building with a possible maximum height of 75 feet, also amending the North Temple Boulevard Plan.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 70 of 2022, for the Ballpark Station Area Plan as part of Salt Lake City's General Plan.
votes.description: Adopts the Ballpark Station Area Plan to guide growth and development in the area between 900 South to 1700 South and State Street to I-15.

votes.motion: Approve Resolution 32 of 2022, the public benefit analysis and ground lease terms for The Other Side Village Pilot Project at 1850 West Indiana Avenue, subject to conditions regarding a Ground Lease and Development Agreement.
votes.description: Authorizes a 40-year below-market ground lease with The Other Side Academy to facilitate construction of a tiny home village with approximately 54 units of affordable housing.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 71 of 2022, amending the zoning map to portions of City-owned properties at 1850 West Indiana Avenue and 1965 West 500 South to rezone the parcels from PL (Public Lands) to FB-UN2 (Form Based Urban Neighborhood).
votes.description: Rezones approximately 37.1 acres to accommodate The Other Side Village, intended for permanent supportive housing for homeless individuals with on-site services.

votes.motion: Appoint Lorena Riffo-Jenson as Department Director of Economic Development.
votes.description: Confirms the Mayor's appointment of Lorena Riffo-Jenson as the Director of Economic Development for Salt Lake City.

votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 33 of 2022, amending the operating agreement and Resolution 34 of 2022 interlocal cooperation agreement for the Utah Performing Arts Center.
votes.description: Approves changes to two interlocal agreements between Salt Lake City, the RDA, and UPACA related to insurance for the Eccles Theater, intended to save taxpayer money.

votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 35 of 2022, authorizing an interlocal agreement between Salt Lake City and the Utah Inland Port Authority.
votes.description: Authorizes the Mayor to execute an interlocal agreement with the Utah Inland Port Authority fulfilling legislative requirements enacted in March 2022, covering environmental and community mitigation spending, affordable housing commitments, and a City point of contact for land use applications.

votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 36 of 2022, and release the holding account funds for Electrified Transportation with legislative intent regarding evaluation of fees for public EV charging.
votes.description: Releases FY2023 Sustainability Department budget contingency funds for Electrified Transportation and directs the department to study implementing fees for public electric vehicle charging stations.

votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 37 of 2022, and release holding account funds related to airport parking lot capital expenditures.
votes.description: Approves the release of FY2023 budget contingency funds for the Department of Airports related to airport parking lot capital expenditures.

votes.motion: Approve the Consent Agenda.
votes.description: Approves multiple consent agenda items including setting public hearing dates for rezones and a digital donation program resolution, approving grant holding account items, and approving board appointments and reappointments.

votes.motion: Approve Resolution 16 of 2022, authorizing an interlocal agreement between the RDA and the Utah Inland Port Authority.
votes.description: The RDA Board authorizes the Mayor as RDA Executive Director to execute the interlocal agreement with the Utah Inland Port Authority fulfilling March 2022 legislative requirements.

votes.motion: Adjourn as the RDA.
votes.description: Formal motion to close the Redevelopment Agency Board meeting.
